entities.name: Boulder
entities.description: A large, friendly wolf in Arlinn Kord's pack on Innistrad who sides with Tovolar.

entities.name: Arlinn Kord
entities.description: Planeswalker and leader of a wolf pack on Innistrad, torn between her human and wolf natures.

entities.name: Tovolar
entities.description: Wolf leader who urges a new, aggressive pack to reclaim the night.

entities.name: Thraben Cathedral
entities.description: Place on Innistrad where Boulder rejoins Arlinn.

events.summary: Boulder joins Arlinn's pack on a hunt, then the pack meets Tovolar, who reveals plans for a new, more aggressive pack; Boulder pledges allegiance to Tovolar, leaving Arlinn betrayed.
events.quote: Boulder showed his allegiance to Tovolar

events.summary: Boulder forcefully pushes Arlinn as she resists Tovolar's call, breaking her ribs.
events.quote: Boulder forcefully pushed her, breaking her ribs

events.summary: In a vision-and-battle episode Arlinn is overwhelmed by her former packmates, Boulder among them.
events.quote: Boulder did not hesitate to use force against her

events.summary: Arlinn wakes injured with Tovolar and her wolves, Boulder included, at her side.
events.quote: Boulder and the others assisted her

events.summary: Boulder rejoins Arlinn in Thraben Cathedral and helps her to her feet as she faces Tovolar.
events.quote: helping them to her feet and staying close

relations.quote: Boulder is a wolf on Innistrad

relations.note: shows loyalty to Tovolar and the new pack
relations.quote: Boulder's loyalty to Tovolar and the new pack
